blocks.text: 4 Repair profile admission
Confirmed cause

Combined mode captures a temperature of 0.49135804 for all three contributors and passes a copied request profile into ChatRepositoryImpl. The permitted function in DirectResearchModelFactory, exposed through its endpoint available callback, requires a live saved profile that equals the entire request profile. The saved temperatures differ for every contributor, so the comparison fails even though the selected profile remains enabled and authorized. ResearchModelCoordinator turns that failure into MODEL_NOT_ADMITTED before any Research model invocation. [C1]
Implementation

Represent the registered profile and the accepted request separately. Capture the registered profile revision, provider connection identity, destination, credential reference and permissions at turn acceptance. Store the accepted model, temperature and generation options as an immutable request overlay. Revalidate the registered authority before each physical dispatch, then apply that accepted overlay.

Reuse ConfiguredDispatchAuthority and its existing registered versus requested profile distinction. Pass this authority into DirectResearchModelFactory and ResearchModelCoordinator instead of comparing the request object against the database object. Preserve legitimate per chat model overrides. A changed destination, changed credential authority, disabled profile, deleted profile or revoked grant must still reject dispatch; UID equality alone is insufficient. [C1]

Return a typed admission result with stage, profile UID, registered revision, accepted policy digest and reason. Distinguish PROFILE_DISABLED, REGISTERED_PROFILE_CHANGED, DESTINATION_CHANGED, PERMISSION_REVOKED, READINESS_TIMEOUT, LOCAL_ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED and MODEL_CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE. Do not run a schema repair attempt after a permanent admission rejection. A planner output parse error and inability to admit a model are different states.

Research should work with Local Assist off, as in this incident. A missing optional helper must not block an authorized remote Research profile. Restore independent Research review through its own reviewer policy; Combined Delegation suppression currently also suppresses the legacy reviewer flag. Keep the Combined Delegation UI removed. [E1, C3]
5 Preserve the shared turn corpus
Confirmed cause

ChatViewModel.startCombinedSynthesis selects the last matching Research export. ResearchSessionStore orders these exports by update time. Xiaomi's newer snapshot has no readable pages, while Luna's earlier snapshot has eight. Choosing the newest snapshot produces the observed 17 title only records. Separately, the failed Luna writer is excluded from the usable contributor drafts. Acquisition quality and draft completion are incorrectly coupled at finalization. [C5, E5]
Implementation

Extend ResearchCorpus and ResearchSessionStore to expose a turn scoped corpus manifest keyed by root turn ID and authorized source partition. Include every eligible participant session for that accepted turn. Select source versions by stable identity and coverage, not by the timestamp of an unrelated participant snapshot. A later failed read must not overwrite previously retained text for the same source version.

Deduplicate canonical URLs and trusted identifiers such as DOI, PMID, PMCID and arXiv version. Retain distinct content versions and do not silently treat a preprint and a published article as independent studies. Preserve a study family identifier only when identity is supported; keep unresolved families explicitly unresolved. Source count, publication count, study count and reviewed outcome count remain different metrics.

The merge key must include authority and content version. Share public evidence only where the accepted profiles may receive it, and keep account scoped sources isolated unless sharing is authorized. Finalization revalidates access before creating its prompt. A shared cache must not widen a tool grant or change which provider receives private material.

Build the synthesis evidence manifest independently from the candidate prose list. A failed writer can still contribute captured passages; a completed fallback with no readable evidence contributes status and leads, not supported factual claims. Record writer status alongside the source manifest without using it as an evidence eligibility filter.

Introduce an atomic acquisition registry for compatible requests. Its key should include root turn, authority partition, canonical source or query, engine configuration, relevant request parameters and freshness policy. Concurrent consumers join an in flight operation and receive its result. A duplicate request becomes SHARED_IN_FLIGHT or CACHE_HIT, not a new source failure. Actual network retries remain separately accounted physical attempts.
6 Make evidence packets useful and inspectable
Confirmed initial packet defect

The initial handoff uses 2,048 handoff tokens, converted to a 6,144 byte budget. The packet builder reserves 1,536 bytes for unread leads before trying readable sources. In a reconstruction using the retained Luna packet and the current serialization rules, one source candidates are approximately 5,796 to 5,855 bytes. They exceed the remaining 4,608 bytes, so all eight readable sources are rejected even though each could fit without that lead reserve. This is a reconstruction of the packet rule, not an executed Kotlin regression test. [E4, C4]
Implementation

Create one canonical packet builder for acquisition handoff, contributor analysis, review, synthesis and repair. Parameterize its role and budget while preserving the same evidence identities. Remove the current independent packet constructions from different request layers, or make both produce receipts that clearly identify their stage and replacement relationship.

Allocate packet space in this order: compact contract and source registry; supported excerpts relevant to required questions; qualifications and conflicting findings; claim and outcome records; additional readable sources; unread leads and diagnostic metadata. Keep engine event history outside the main evidence payload unless the writer needs a concise limitation.

Pack passages incrementally. Shorten or split evidence excerpts at recorded passage boundaries and retain their source version and offset. Never invent a shortened quote. If readable evidence exists and the context can fit a minimal supported packet, include at least one useful excerpt before adding unread leads. If even the minimum cannot fit, emit EVIDENCE_PACKET_TOO_SMALL and stop the writer with a recoverable result.

Respect model context limits and explicit user limits. Compute the final serialized request after all system instructions and tool schemas are applied. Prefer the model tokenizer when available; otherwise label the byte based estimate and preserve margin. Do not double count the same source payload in a user handoff and appended system packet.

Persist an EvidencePacketReceipt for every physical writer or reviewer attempt: packet ID and digest, parent corpus revision, role, admitted source IDs, excerpt bytes, estimated or measured tokens, omitted IDs and reasons, contract version, model context limit and output reserve. Record the receipt after final prompt composition. The initial debug request in this export is too early to establish the later provider payload.
7 Unify citation and report delivery

The initial system prompt prohibits source IDs, inline citations and a References section, while the Research contract requires them. ResearchDeliverySession later appends additional instructions, making the effective request harder to inspect. The actual delivery checks rejected unknown citations, unregistered URLs, unsupported paragraphs and missing review disclosures. Prompt conflict is a supported contributor to these failures; it is not proof that every validation error has the same cause. [E4, C6]
One trusted contract

Resolve a CitationPolicy once when Research is accepted. The Research policy requires exact source and passage references internally. The UI may render them as clean study cards or citation chips. An ordinary chat preference for minimal visible citations must not disable internal evidence binding while the Research validator requires it.

Place app authored format and citation rules in the trusted instruction layer. Place retrieved article text in a clearly delimited data payload. Do not bundle application instructions inside a block labeled untrusted evidence and then depend on the model to treat them as authoritative. Retrieved source text cannot change tools, permissions, the task or the citation contract.

Construct a role specific report contract. Contributors should produce concise evidence notes for the merger; the final writer should produce the user requested answer length and organization. The current detailed report guidance of 1,200 to 1,800 words does not belong indiscriminately on a compact 2,048 token contribution. Derive the output reserve from the accepted role, requested length and actual provider limit, and clearly report a shorter feasible output when a hard limit binds.
Validation and recovery

Validate source IDs and URLs against the packet registry. Validate quote spans and numerical values against captured passages. Keep structural checks separate from semantic assessment of support, qualification, contradiction and relevance. Passing a format check does not establish scientific accuracy; repeated agreement between models does not create independent evidence.

Perform no evidence based writer call when the eligible packet contains only unread leads. Return a concise discovery result with its unread status and Continue research action. When evidence exists but claims are not reviewed, permit a qualified partial summary that identifies its limited basis. Preserve the user's requested subject and do not create long empty report sections merely to satisfy a template.

Permit a targeted repair only when it has a concrete input change or addressable validation defect. Stop repeated full rewrites when there is no additional evidence or no progress. A zero visible output limit failure must enter recovery even when the provider returned HTTP 200. Save the evidence and a checkpoint; use an authorized healthy writer or resume the current writer with a compatible output contract. Preserve explicit user ceilings.

Repair ResearchDeliverySession's early return after an initial ProviderEvent.Failed. It currently bypasses the later repair and deterministic fallback paths. Classify recoverable output limits and interruptions, retain any buffered draft as an unvalidated checkpoint and route eligible failures into recovery. Permission revocation must still abort without disclosing cached evidence. [C6]

Use the workflow phase, not collection completeness, to control new acquisition. A partial collection can be intentionally ready for final writing. Entering that phase disables new search and crawling while permitting only an authorized saved evidence reader where needed. The current completeness based tool switch can reopen acquisition while the app is trying to finish. [C6]
8 Keep the turn alive and the result visible
Root lifecycle ownership

AgentRunForegroundService currently observes active child runs and schedules an idle stop. Combined synthesis is created after contributor completion through ChatViewModel, leaving a gap in which the service sees no active run. Increasing a short delay would only make that race less frequent. [C7]

Create an application owned root turn coordinator. Acquire its execution lease from the user initiated start, persist accepted successor obligations, and hold the lease through acquisition, contributor analysis, review, finalization and delivery commit. Child completion releases only its child lease. UI disposal or activity backgrounding must not own successor creation.

Compute service need from active operations plus admitted pending successors and active root leases. Reserve and persist the next stage before releasing the previous stage. The coordinator should survive navigation and reconstruct work from durable checkpoints after process death, with a root revision and ownership fence preventing duplicate finalization.

Android restricts foreground service starts from the background. If a restart is denied, persist PAUSED_REQUIRES_FOREGROUND with a Resume action that the user can invoke from the app or notification. Keep the source corpus and last useful visible artifact. Do not repeatedly issue the same prohibited start or rely on disabling battery optimization. WorkManager can schedule eligible deferred work, but long running workers still involve foreground services and Android 16 job quotas; it is not an unrestricted substitute for this lifecycle design. [A1, A2]
Transactional visible delivery

Keep the current displayed artifact while a replacement is prepared in a separate pending generation. The successful replacement should commit atomically with its message revision and generation ownership. On failure, display an explicit partial result or paused state and retain a path to the prior candidate. Never label an individual draft as a delivered Combined answer. [C8]

Use the chat database as the authoritative record for the visible artifact and terminal transition. Where Research data or budgets live in separate stores, use a transactional outbox and idempotent updates rather than claiming a Room transaction spans unrelated databases. On recovery, reconcile the root state, stage obligations and reservations from that transition record.

9 Fund the accepted Research plan

prepareCombinedTurn currently sends no effective Research source goal into CombinedPolicyResolver. CombinedWorkInventory primarily infers required evidence from a numeric source count or URLs in the text prompt. For this ordinary prompt, it creates optional evidence work with four remaining units and a 20 operation optional allowance. All twenty physical tool reservations in the export used that pool. The explicit Research selection therefore competes with optional work instead of receiving its own allocation. [C2, E3]
Accepted settings contract

Extend the accepted turn record with effective Research scope, depth, readable source goal, enabled engine and reader grants, reviewer selection, report detail, freshness policy and true user limits. Apply preference precedence consistently: accepted per chat choice, applicable profile defaults, then global defaults. Permissions are an intersection of applicable chat, profile, source and global restrictions; a chat preference cannot override a disabled plugin, revoked grant or source sharing restriction. Persist the source of each effective value. Do not reinterpret a depth percentage as a literal page count.

Admit the finite Research goal as required work even when the prompt has no number. A goal is a target for useful evidence, not a guarantee that enough relevant studies exist. If real hard limits cannot fund it, preserve the requested goal and record the admitted partial plan with the specific limiting dimension. An app planning tranche must not silently become a user imposed ceiling.

Give discovery, reading, extraction, independent review, contributor notes and final writing distinct work assignments and reservations. The existing RESEARCH and VERIFIER owner mapping both use verification, and child dispatch can drop a work item ID. Repair those mappings before enabling the newly admitted Research model calls. Preserve assignment and authority through role changes, nested readers, retries and resume. [C3]

Allocate enough reading capacity before expanding discovery. Requesting 24 readable sources cannot generally fit within twenty total physical operations once searches and failed attempts are counted. Use incremental tranches based on remaining accepted work, source yield and user limits. Continue within the accepted goal without adding hidden safety caps. Full scale renewal should correspond to concrete unfinished work; cancellation and true resource ceilings remain effective.

Record a physical operation once. A federated search may create several engine requests, and a generic search followed by an attached crawler must not also create a second independently owned Research read. Track logical tool calls, physical requests, retries, cache hits, shared results, bytes and model tokens separately.
Accurate limit feedback

Replace boolean exhaustion with a ResearchStopReason carrying origin, scope, resource dimension, owner, limit, used amount, denied operation and available action. In this incident the correct label is Combined planning allowance reached. The existing advice to increase Maximum Tool Calls points to a profile limit already set to 2,147,483,647. Do not present the UI counter of thirty as a measured number of physical tool calls without reconciling its source. [E3, C9]
10 Repair search and reader behavior

Separate transport health, authentication, admission and evidence usefulness. DuckDuckGo and Exa returned successful search responses in the incident. Perplexity returned an observed HTTP 401, and an examine.com read returned HTTP 429. Later generic search results included six AUTH_REQUIRED entries and three application budget denials; these are not six independently observed HTTP 401 responses or evidence that every engine failed. [E4]

blocks.text: Scope connection health to connection identity, credential revision and tool capability. A failed search endpoint must not disable an unrelated reader or the OpenRouter chat model. Retain the original HTTP category through ResearchSource status instead of reducing RATE_LIMITED to generic Blocked. Report attempted and unattempted operations separately so per engine success percentages use a meaningful denominator.

When the Research scheduler owns acquisition, bypass generic SearchCrawlStage enrichment and route all reads through the same queue. Prefer metadata APIs or eligible article formats when the selected scope includes Papers and studies. General Web only searches can still discover academic pages, but that does not mean the dedicated academic engines ran. Preserve the user's explicit scope and native fallback selection.

Integrate the planned Crawler interface as one reader adapter with fetch, start, status, results and cancel operations. A long crawl becomes a persistent job linked to the accepted turn and source goal. Persist cursors, canonical URLs, content hashes, bytes, engine version and document coverage. Charge each physical request and reuse compatible cached bodies. Keep fetched pages as untrusted data and enforce the existing network and source access rules.
11 Improve study cards Examine and archive

Current main already contains study collections, three compact initial cards, View all, versioned review records and archive integration. Harden those components rather than replacing them with another card system. The exported feature flags are enabled, but the bundle does not include the database receipts needed to establish their actual save and display outcomes. [C10, E1]
Clean Research interface

Use one persistent Research status bubble above the result. Show the current stage, readable source count, unique source count, reviewed study count and a concise partial or completed label. Expand into engine details, accepted settings and limits only on tap. Keep development terms such as ownership fences, policy digests and invocation IDs inside debug views.

For the observed Research journals, a truthful summary is 17 sources found, 8 pages read, 0 reviewed claims recorded, Research incomplete. The new UI must query examination records before displaying study review totals; this export does not establish that total. A Web only source should be labeled Source or Article until its type is established. Do not label every discovered webpage as a study. A partial writer result and an unread lead need visibly distinct states.

Each study card should show title, study type and year when verified, a short supported conclusion, one limitation, coverage and review status. Retain the theme tinted visual style, readable contrast and compact expandable details. Show three cards initially with a virtualized collection for all results. Cards must remain accessible during streaming, after writer failure and after a background pause because their data belongs to the corpus.
Examine readiness and workflow

Resolve the review profile from an explicit Examine choice, the saved chat crawler profile, then the global Research profile. This incident has no configured crawler profile in either chat or global settings. Present Choose review profile at the point of use; do not silently swallow readiness failures or invent a different destination. Validate capability and current authority before starting. [C11]

Use persistent stages: resolving article identity, retrieving available material, extracting supported fields, reviewing the conclusion, saving the assessment and updating the card. Show whether the reader saw full text, partial text, an abstract or metadata only. Cache each completed stage so Re examine can reuse unchanged authorized material while creating a new review revision.

Keep independent review separate from the initial model's self check. If an independent reviewer is unavailable, save the evidence and label the result Review incomplete or Self checked as applicable. Research reviewer policy should remain available even with Combined Delegation disabled.
Scores and version integrity

Preserve the existing rubric: Reliability and Summary accuracy are separate components; the overall review score is the lower component only when both are eligible. Scores use five point increments. Unknown domains, missing passage references, inadequate coverage and unresolved critical concerns must not receive a favorable numeric score. Display AI review score rather than a probability that the paper is true. [C12]

Tie a review to work ID, content version, outcome, exact summary hash, rubric, profile and model. A card for an older cited version must not silently display a newer version's score. GPT Mobile Research Study Cards Design

Feature design and implementation specification
18 October 2026

Research mode should build a growing collection of distinct studies, display clear conclusions in themed cards, and let the user examine each study with a selected AI profile. Every examination should produce an evidence-linked assessment that updates the same Research Archive record and the visible card.

The central design decision is to separate methodological reliability from summary accuracy. A review score combines these two app assessments conservatively. It never represents the probability that a scientific finding is true. The paper, the outcome being assessed, the source version and the generated conclusion remain identifiable throughout the workflow.
Product requirements
Discover broadly across available Research providers and preserve every eligible distinct work in the response collection, even when the final prose does not cite it.
Show a title, plain-language conclusion, key limitation, access coverage, review status and Examine action in each study card.
Save a default Crawler AI profile in the Research page. Use that profile consistently for manual and automatic examination.
Generate review scores from structured, source-linked judgments; display pending or limited states when evidence is insufficient.
Save discoveries immediately and append examination revisions transactionally. Keep chat cards and the archive synchronized.
Support cancellation, resume, repeated examination, source changes, profile failures and backup restoration without duplicate entries or lost completed reviews.
Current implementation baseline

The reviewed main revision is d1da61ae2f21c0cab4e231fc1dac5576080afeee. It already contains citation cards, strong identifiers, study families, a versioned archive, structured appraisal with schema and evidence checks, and resumable examination. Cards show metadata and extracted fields but no plain-language conclusion or score. Their membership depends on citations, and their saved snapshots do not observe later appraisals. The Research settings do not persist an examination profile. [R1-R6]

A Research answer should contain a concise synthesis followed by a Studies found collection. Cards stream in as metadata and source-grounded previews become available. The prose and collection are linked, while discovery progress continues independently of how much text the answer contains.

3  What the score means

blocks.text: Cochrane RoB 2 evaluates a particular trial result using domain judgments and written justification. GRADE assesses certainty for a body of evidence by outcome. Preserve these distinctions: the proposed numeric card score is an app rubric, not a GRADE rating or a validated scientific probability. [S1, S2]
A conservative combined value

Display AI review score on a 0 to 100 scale in five-point increments. When both component scores are eligible, the overall score is the lower of Reliability and Summary accuracy. Reliability 65 and Summary accuracy 95 produce a review score of 65. A faithful summary cannot make weak methods more reliable, and sound methods cannot compensate for a misleading summary.

Keep both components one tap away, with the rubric version, evidence references and the short explanation behind each judgment. Do not use percent signs or a badge that says scientifically proven. Retain domain concerns beside the number so a numerical total cannot conceal a serious limitation.

blocks.text: 4  The proposed app rubric

The score calculator consumes evidence-linked judgments. It must not ask the language model to invent a reliability number. The following v1 rubric is a product proposal that requires comparison with expert assessments before it is presented as a dependable quality indicator.
Reliability domains

rows: What the selected study-type module checks
Whether the design and comparator support the specific inference.
Selection, assignment, baseline differences and relevant confounders.
Outcome/exposure measurement, relevant blinding, follow-up and conduct.
Appropriate analysis, uncertainty, attrition, missing data and robustness.
Agreement of methods, outcomes and results with any available protocol or registration.

blocks.text: Summary accuracy domains

rows: Population, setting, scope and study type are represented correctly.
Intervention or exposure, comparator and relevant conditions match.
Outcome, measurement units, effect size and time point are preserved.
Positive, negative or null direction and uncertainty are stated faithfully.
Causal language, generalization limits and material caveats are preserved.

blocks.text: Grade each domain from 0 to 4; five times their sum gives the component. Reliability grades run from documented material failure through major, some and minor concerns to no identified concern. Accuracy grades run from contradicted or unsupported through mostly unsupported, partly supported and mostly supported to supported content. Unknown is null. A critical flaw, material contradiction or unresolved integrity issue makes the overall score null; raw components remain in details/history.

Each supported module needs five meaningful domains and versioned signaling rules before numeric display. Not applicable is allowed only for an individual check with a reason; it never earns full points. An unevaluable domain makes the component and overall null. Unsupported designs receive qualitative review; protocols/commentaries have no observed-result Reliability. Keep scientific judgments intact. Prestige, citation count, peer review and AI agreement do not automatically earn points. [R3]
5  Examine and the crawler profile
Research settings

Add Crawler AI profile to the Research page, with a saved profile UID and the selected profile’s name. It supplies the examination intelligence; the app owns source retrieval, tool execution and job state. This avoids assuming that a profile can browse simply because it can generate text.

Resolution order is an explicit per-study override, then the chat’s saved Research profile setting, then the global Research default. Save the resolved profile, model and runtime configuration in the job before execution. If the profile is deleted, disabled or unavailable, show Choose profile or Resume when available. Never silently change provider or switch a local profile to an online one.

Keep the existing automatic-examination setting, presented as Manual, When needed or All eligible. Preserve the current choice during migration. Manual Examine uses the same coordinator and persistence as automatic examination. Advanced settings may expose a separate reviewer, crawl breadth and resource budgets without adding a new required configuration screen.
Examination pipeline

1. Resolve and reuse.  Check canonical identity, source version, recent archive content and an existing compatible completed review. A normal repeated tap opens the result; explicit Re-examine creates a new revision.

2. Fetch.  Prefer native scholarly metadata and open-access structured text; then authorized publisher HTML/PDF and a targeted crawler. Add a URL-only route for legitimate sources without scholarly identifiers. [R4, S5]

3. Inspect the required material.  Capture relevant methods, results, limitations, protocol and any material tables, figures or supplements. Record inspected, unavailable and not-applicable content separately.

4. Extract and appraise.  Use the selected profile on section-aware chunks with overlapping context where needed. Every substantive claim or favorable judgment must reference an exact stored passage or validated table location.

5. Validate and refine.  Check identifiers, source hashes, units, sample counts, effect direction, uncertainty, inference and contradictions. Produce a short source-grounded conclusion plus a key limitation.
6. Calculate.  Aggregate evidence for the whole assessed outcome. Apply eligibility rules, component rubrics and critical overrides in deterministic application code.
7. Commit.  Append the completed assessment, its evidence and the selected archive pointer in one transaction. Notify the card and archive observers only after the commit succeeds.
8. Explain.  Show Reviewed or Limited review, what material was inspected, what changed and where the assessment was saved. Offer View review and explicit Re-examine.

Keep job completion, source coverage and score eligibility as separate properties. A completed crawl may still have only an abstract. A full-text review may be adequate for one outcome while a different outcome depends on an unread supplement. “Finalized” means the assessment of a specified version and scope has been saved.

Versioned records

1. Response study attachment.  Store chat, run, message revision, work, publication version, assessed outcome, discovery provenance and stable order. Use the result registry, not generated citation text, as the membership source.

2. Study conclusion revision.  Store the displayed conclusion and key limitation, language, outcome scope, summary hash, source version and supporting evidence IDs. A materially changed conclusion gets a new revision.

3. Review assessment.  Store eligibility, Reliability, Summary accuracy, combined score, raw domain judgments, critical flags, coverage, reasons, rubric version, profile/model configuration, source hashes and review time.

4. Current assessment selection.  Select the current compatible completed review for a work/version/outcome/summary. Append prior assessments to history; do not overwrite their evidence or timestamps.
Two views of the same evidence

Historic message citations remain pinned to their original source version. The visible card may show a newer assessment through a separate live projection, with a clear Updated assessment label and access to both revisions. If the newer source changes the result, mark the earlier synthesis as needing review and offer to regenerate it; do not silently rewrite the whole answer.

Reliability reuse requires the same outcome, appraisal revision, rubric and evidence fingerprint covering article, protocol and supplement hashes, plus current integrity and freshness checks. Summary accuracy also requires a hash of all scored text, including the conclusion and key limitation. A changed evidence packet or summary invalidates reuse of the affected score.

Commit assessment, conclusion, archive selection and references atomically. Publish Saved only after success.
Keep uniqueness constraints and compare-and-set revision checks for concurrent completions.
Preserve study-family, version and citation roots during deletion and archive pruning; never leave dangling reviews.
When storage reaches its configured limit, expose the state and retention policy. Do not silently lose newly examined studies.
Backup and restore must preserve review history, profile identity, rubric versions, source evidence and paused jobs. Older records start as Unscored, never as zero.

Executive decision

Build one optional Universal Marketplace plugin with a native Android coordinator and independently enabled marketplace adapters. Give the user one search, one results workspace, one comparison flow and one settings page. Keep Facebook Marketplace, eBay, Craigslist and Kijiji visible as sources, while accurately distinguishing which sources can return listings automatically.

The baseline must work without subscriptions, API payments, a PC, a hosted service or an AI model. It prepares user-opened searches and stores user-created searches and bookmarks. Automatic listing aggregation is an additional capability, available only through approved or otherwise permitted data access. An optional user-controlled gateway can host authorized API integrations or an explicitly configured discovery engine.

Do not advertise “free live search across every marketplace.” The software can be free while a platform's data access remains restricted. A prepared Facebook search is not a retrieved Facebook listing; an indexed web hit is not confirmed stock or price.
What this specification delivers

This document defines repository integration points, source-access policy, data and tool contracts, execution rules, UI behavior, local/remote AI integration, storage, security, test cases and a sequenced implementation backlog. All new symbols and file paths are proposed unless explicitly identified as reviewed existing code.

The review sampled the native plugin catalog, installation registry, native request builder, MCP metadata registry and Amazon contracts. It did not execute the app, perform live marketplace searches, audit the entire call graph or validate production API approval. Those checks are explicit implementation gates, not assumed completed work.

1. Product scope and free-first rules
Required product outcome

A user can request, for example, “Find a used graphics card under CAD 800 around Toronto” and receive an honest source-by-source outcome. The app should retrieve permitted listings concurrently, offer external searches for other sources, preserve the budget and location filters, and explain unsupported filters rather than silently dropping them.

Use Universal Marketplace for the product feature and Plugin Marketplace for the existing app installation catalog. This naming distinction prevents the new shopping feature from being confused with the repository's existing data/​marketplace infrastructure.

“Free” refers to the plugin's baseline service requirements. Device electricity, connectivity, optional hosting and a selected remote AI provider can still carry costs. Provider rules and approval remain independent of software licensing.

Native layer

Use Kotlin, coroutines, Hilt and repository/ViewModel separation consistent with the existing app. The coordinator is independent of Compose and AI clients. An adapter returns typed data or a typed failure; it does not render UI, call an AI model, inspect another provider's credentials or mutate global chat permissions.

Each adapter exposes a capability descriptor: source identifier, access mode, supported regions, supported filters, authentication needs, permitted operations, pagination support, ranking restrictions, display requirements, caching policy and monitoring policy. Default unknown permissions to disabled rather than assuming permission.
Optional gateway layer

Support a configured, authenticated gateway only where it provides a necessary capability, such as protecting an approved eBay confidential client secret or running a user-controlled discovery service. Reuse the app's existing connection machinery after validating its available transport; do not hardcode a port or assume stdio runs inside Android.

For a single search, each provider has one execution owner: native or gateway. Do not query both and charge the same quota twice. An unavailable gateway should produce a provider-specific status and preserve native external-search actions.
Packaging and update boundary

Ship the small native engine and adapters with the app, behind an optional installation/enablement entry. Downloadable metadata can register supported behavior; it must not introduce arbitrary Kotlin, DEX, JavaScript or shell execution. Larger companion services remain separate.

Use one execution entry point for the UI and chat tool. Manual UI use should not depend on a model's ability to call tools. Loading the screen must not start marketplace network requests until the user searches or explicitly opens a saved query.
Disable and uninstall behavior

Disabling cancels active work and stops future monitoring. Uninstall disables first, removes tool exposure, cancels scheduled jobs and then deletes owned secrets/configuration. 6. Search request contract
This is the proposed canonical request used by both the screen and the master tool. Generate runtime-specific tool schemas from one definition; do not maintain separate local and remote meanings.

{
  "query": "used graphics card",
  "providers": ["facebook", "ebay", "craigslist", "kijiji"],
  "country": "CA",
  "city": "Toronto",
  "radius_km": 50,
  "currency": "CAD",
  "max_price_minor": 80000,
  "price_basis": "item",
  "fulfilment": "any",
  "condition": "used",
  "sort": "relevance",
  "max_results": 30,
  "cursor": null
}
Validation and defaulting

Require a trimmed query of 1–250 characters and one or more recognized provider IDs, deduplicated before planning. Reject control characters and unknown properties. Validate country and currency against supported configurations. Defaults come from the visible plugin settings, never from hidden geolocation assumptions.

Money is an integer number of the currency's minor units, not a binary floating-point amount. 80000 means CAD 800.00 in this example. Reject negative budgets and overflow. Define price_basis explicitly as item price or known item-plus-shipping; neither includes unknown tax or import charges.

radius_km is a non-negative bounded request preference. Each adapter reports whether the radius was enforced, approximated or unsupported. A city-only source cannot claim an exact 50 km match. Coordinates are an optional separate extension, requiring explicit location consent; they are not necessary for the launch contract.

fulfilment is any, pickup or shipping. condition uses a documented vocabulary with any as the fallback; unknown source conditions remain unknown. Only documented sorts are accepted. Proposed result bounds are 1–100; the initial default is 30. Actual provider and UI limits may be lower and must be reported.
Pagination and query identity

Use an opaque cursor bound to a normalized query fingerprint, source capability version and execution owner. A cursor from another query is invalid. Keep per-provider continuation state internally; never expose credentials or raw authorization tokens. A follow-up changes the fingerprint only when filters change. New pages cannot rewrite the evidence of previously displayed items without a visible refresh event.
The example is a request fixture, not a claim about currently available products or prices.

Required records

A listing carries provider_id, listing_id, canonical URL, title, item money or null, shipping money or null, condition, fulfilment, optional image, location precision, optional distance, observation time, availability state, source mode and applied-filter evidence. Unknown price is null, not zero. An image or title from the AI is never a listing field.

A discovery carries its URL, title, snippet, engine, retrieval time and explicit unknown filter status. A search action carries provider, generated URL, user-visible label and filters that still require selection on site. Neither is promoted to a listing without a separate permitted fetch.
State semantics

Provider states include success, no_results, link_ready, disabled, approval_required, credentials_required, unsupported_region, rate_limited, blocked, timeout, network_error and parse_error. A failure plus a fallback link retains the failure and the action separately.

Overall outcomes distinguish results, partial, links_only, no_results and unavailable. Link-only support is intentional coverage, not an automatic retrieval success. No production path may return mock products on a blocked response.
8. Coordinator execution and reliability
Execution sequence

Validate and snapshot the request and permissions. Determine each source's allowed mode and applied filters. Publish the plan before beginning network work. Produce external actions locally, then run eligible retrieval adapters with bounded concurrency. Validate and normalize each response before emitting it. Merge source events into one immutable UI state and finish with a truthful coverage summary.

Use a supervisor scope so one failing provider does not cancel other providers. Preserve cancellation exceptions; a user cancellation stops all outstanding work. Results from an older request ID must never enter a newer search. Never let a slow source postpone already available cards or search actions.

blocks.text: Readiness and filter feedback

A provider that cannot honor a strict filter is not silently treated as matching it. For example, a discovery with unknown currency belongs in a clearly separate unconfirmed section. The planner can still generate a search action with a notice to set those filters on the destination site.

Distinguish a successful empty response from an inaccessible source. Cache hits carry the original observation time and a cached flag. Returning a cached result after a network failure must preserve that failure and obey the provider's display-age policy.
Single-flight and quota accounting

Coalesce identical in-flight requests only when permissions, provider account, region, filters and execution owner match. Each consumer can detach independently; cancel shared work when no consumers remain. Count attempted upstream calls, retries and details requests against the appropriate quota. A master-tool call is not equivalent to one upstream API request.

Keep a per-provider cooldown after repeated blocking or schema failures. Offer a retry or external search, not an invisible crawler fallback. No automatic request loop is allowed to keep a spinner alive indefinitely.
9. Prices, location, matching and ranking
Price normalization

Store exact monetary values as bounded integer minor units with a currency code, while retaining the original display value when permitted. Parse locale-specific formatting without guessing whether a comma is a thousands separator or decimal separator. Unsupported or ambiguous amounts remain unknown and receive a validation notice.

A known item-plus-shipping amount can be computed only when both components are known and use the same currency. Unknown shipping, tax, duties or fees are not zero. Show “CAD 450 + shipping unknown,” not “Total CAD 450.” Auction bids, deposits, financing instalments, bundles and “from” prices require distinct price kinds and must not be ranked as equivalent buy-now offers.

Keep different currencies in separate comparison groups by default. Optional conversion requires a dated, identified rate source and a visible estimate label. Do not add a paid FX service to the baseline or fetch new rates merely to display an existing source price.
Geographic behavior

Use the selected country and city as the default location context. Do not infer a precise user position. When explicit coordinates are available, distinguish exact provider distance from an estimate based on a city centroid. Label distance precision and avoid displaying decimals that suggest unsupported accuracy.

Adapters convert kilometres to the source's documented units at the boundary and test the conversion. Unsupported postal codes, cities or regions produce an actionable state. Never replace a Canadian location with a US city or ZIP code silently.
Duplicate handling

First deduplicate exact provider-plus-listing identifiers. Normalize only safe URL components; preserve meaningful item variations and provider-required attribution parameters. Cross-site similarities become a possible duplicate group based on title, model, price, location and permitted image evidence. Preserve every original source and allow the user to expand the group. Similarity is not proof of the same seller or physical item.
Ranking

Filter eligibility before ranking. Use deterministic relevance and comparable known price as the baseline, with explicit condition and fulfilment preferences. Respect any provider-specific display or ordering restrictions established for the approved integration; disable incompatible cross-source ranking for that source.

An optional value indicator must expose its comparable set, sample size, observation dates and missing fields. Do not call something a “great deal” solely because a generated model description says so. Ask-price comparisons are not completed-sale values. With too little comparable evidence, show “Insufficient price evidence” instead of a confident score.

Cards and details

A retrieved listing card includes source, image when provided, title, condition, item price, shipping state, approximate location and observation time. Make the whole card open details; the details view contains the explicit Open on [site] action. Show unknown states as text, not decorative zeros or optimistic green badges.

Discovery cards use a different badge and emphasize that details need confirmation. External-search rows are navigation actions without fabricated photos, prices or seller details. The all-links state should read: “No listings retrieved. Searches are ready on 4 sites.” Never display “Searched 4 marketplaces successfully” for this state.

Details support accessible next/previous navigation, source attribution, save, and comparison selection. Optional price history must say “Observed by this app” and identify sampling gaps; no history graph is shown when there are no observations.
Settings: four groups

Sources: enablement, access mode and readiness per source. Search: location, currency and result preferences. AI assistance: off, local, or selected remote profile with cost awareness. Privacy & advanced: gateway, cache, diagnostics, deletion and permitted alerts. Advanced credentials remain inside the relevant source settings, not the main workspace.

Use the app's current theme/glass components rather than a second style system. Proposed modal treatment is theme-tinted, approximately 85% opaque with an opaque fallback, no redundant outline, and restrained blur. Preserve contrast in dark/light themes, large text, reduced motion, TalkBack labels, minimum touch targets and keyboard insets. Do not encode provider states only with red/green colour.
11. AI, local tools and combined-mode integration
AI is an enhancement, not the search engine

The model may convert natural language into validated filters, help distinguish a product from accessories, summarize a small comparison set and suggest questions the user could ask manually. It does not decide provider authorization, manufacture missing fields, retrieve cookies, open purchase flows or override a disabled source.

Keep user intent and displayed filters synchronized. When an AI interprets “under $800,” use the visible currency setting or request clarification; do not assume USD inside a Canadian query. Failed structured output leaves the manual form usable.
Tool exposure and local runtime requirements

Use one canonical schema for all clients, with a deterministic simplified representation only where a runtime needs it. Both forms must map to the same validated request. Keep a compact description explaining listings, discoveries and search_actions so small local models do not claim that prepared links are fetched products.

Add an integration test that proves the tool schema reaches the final local-model request, survives relevant context selection, produces an executable call, and returns a visible result or error. A text statement such as “I searched” is not evidence of dispatch. A local model that cannot invoke the tool must not block direct UI searches.
Bounded evidence handoff

Return a compact summary of the top relevant items and provider statuses to the model. Keep full card data outside the prompt. Default to at most ten compact item records for analysis; fetch details only for an explicit subset. Include stable source IDs, observation times, unknown-price flags and provenance on every record. Do not pass image bytes, raw HTML or full search history by default.
Combined mode

Within a combined conversation, share an identical permitted search through a request-scoped evidence store or single-flight coordinator. Multiple profiles should not independently repeat the same provider requests. A profile receives only data permitted by its own grants; no cross-profile credential or location leakage is acceptable.

Final synthesis must retain all requested product categories and distinguish disagreement, missing evidence and retrieval failures. It should cite original listing links, not another AI profile as proof of price. Ranking explanations and final word limits remain subordinate to the user's instructions.

No AI output may silently turn an indexed snippet into a retrieved listing, infer seller trustworthiness, or generate a guaranteed “scam-free” badge. Treat all listing text and snippets as untrusted data, never as tool instructions.
12. Security, privacy and provider boundaries
Credentials and transport

Use the existing SecretVault through a narrowly scoped provider credential repository; persist opaque references rather than secret values. The registry review confirms vault references but is not a complete audit of vault internals. Verify encryption, backup behavior and deletion in implementation tests. [R4]

Do not embed a shared eBay client secret in the APK, a downloadable package, source control, logs or model context. For an approved confidential-client integration, keep that secret on the user-controlled or approved backend. The phone stores only its scoped gateway credential. Storing a shared embedded client secret in Android Keystore does not make the distributed application confidential.

User-selected gateway endpoints require explicit configuration and authentication. Production transport must be encrypted. Any private-network development exception is opt-in, isolated and prohibited from silently weakening all provider requests. Neither a model response nor a listing URL can change the configured gateway origin.
URL and content handling

Allowlist expected provider origins and reviewed image hosts per adapter. Reject embedded credentials, unsupported schemes and malformed URLs. Revalidate redirects; never forward one provider's Authorization header to another origin. Gateway server-side fetching must reject loopback, link-local and private destinations unless an independently configured internal service specifically permits them.

External navigation opens the destination app or browser with a clear label; GPT Mobile does not capture the browser's authenticated session. Do not add WebView cookie interception, private GraphQL replay, CAPTCHA solving or proxy rotation as a fallback.

Limit response bytes, decompressed size, nesting and image decode dimensions. Sanitize displayed HTML or render plain text. Treat snippets, descriptions and gateway responses as untrusted input. Tool calls are accepted only from the validated execution channel, not text embedded inside listing content.
User data and consent

Manual country/city is sufficient for launch. Device location is optional, requested only for a user-selected feature and subject to profile permission. Do not send coordinates to sources that cannot use them. Do not store a precise home location in analytics or backup by default.

Log request IDs, provider codes, timings and counts rather than raw searches, seller contacts, tokens or URLs containing secrets. Debug exports must be scrubbed. Remote AI receives only the selected comparison evidence after the relevant profile permissions apply. Installation alone does not consent to remote analysis or monitoring.

Maintain a provider permission register. A source-wide kill switch disables automatic access and monitoring while leaving safe local user data intact. Changed terms or revoked approval require a new release decision, not an optimistic retry strategy.

Separate saved_search, bookmark and optional observation responsibilities. A saved query is not an archived copy of a provider's content. Expiring cached listing content must not delete the user's query, but may leave a bookmark with only its URL and notes.
Caching rules

Key caches by normalized query, source, region, account/permission scope and adapter version. Do not reuse one user's private or gateway-specific results for another scope. Freshness limits come from the provider's approved contract and validated policy, not one universal cache duration.

A stale-but-displayable result retains its timestamp and visible stale indicator. Content past an allowed display age is removed or replaced with a link/refresh state. Image caching follows the same rights and expiry boundaries as listing content.
Monitoring is a later, separate opt-in

Offer alerts only for providers whose access and retention policy permits repeated retrieval. Use bounded, best-effort background scheduling with network, battery and quota constraints; do not promise exact notification timing. A link-only provider has no automatic new-listing or price-drop alert.

Deduplicate notifications by source, listing/offer identity and meaningful state change. Price-drop alerts require comparable complete observations; an unknown shipping amount or changed bundle cannot become a confirmed saving. Disabling, uninstalling, revoking credentials or restoring a backup must leave monitoring stopped until explicitly re-enabled.
14. Diagnostics and performance requirements
Instrument the real execution path

Emit structured events for request validation, permission resolution, tool exposure, dispatch, provider start/finish, normalization, partial completion, user cancellation and first visible content. Carry request_id, source ID, adapter version, execution owner, access mode, duration, returned counts, cache state and typed error code.

Record resolved / exposed / invoked / completed separately for the master tool. This is necessary to distinguish a missing tool schema from a provider failure. The diagnostics screen must not show healthy retrieval merely because a plugin is installed or a connection responds.

rows: Publish locally generated search actions without waiting for network or AI. Target p95 below 300 ms on the test device.
Search state changes immediately; no blank assistant bubble while waiting for tools.
Default bounded 15-second budget; partial results remain visible. Not a promise about upstream response time.
Cancel in-flight calls and ignore late events. Target local cancellation propagation below 500 ms.
No parsing, database writes, network or large image decoding on the main thread.
Search success must not require a second model call; analysis is separately measured and optional.
Record APK/AAB delta; add no Node, Chromium or browser-automation runtime to the baseline.

blocks.text: These are proposed engineering targets, not measured results. Validate cold/warm runs, offline operation, a slow gateway, a source timeout, large text and low-memory behavior on representative devices.
Debug export

Include app commit, plugin/adapter versions, a sanitized request fingerprint, capability plan, tool-inventory decisions, provider timing spans, response-schema validation failures and final UI outcome. Full queries or sanitized fixtures require an explicit diagnostic option; credentials and browser session data are never exportable.

Provide a fixture-only debug mode with an unmistakable Sample data banner. Build checks must prove that production error handling cannot activate fixtures or simulated products. A successful HTTP response containing a login/challenge page is an error, not a successful empty search.

Use one feature branch for the coherent feature, with small reviewable commits: contracts/tests; native registration/dispatch; coordinator/adapters; screen/settings; tool exposure/rendering; storage; authorized integrations; hardening/documentation. The useful native link-first release can ship after Phases 0–3 and applicable hardening. Do not hold it hostage to a platform's API approval, and do not bypass permission to make Phase 4 look finished. Conversely, do not call Phase 2 a completed automatic multi-marketplace aggregator.
Definition of done

Every advertised control changes real behavior. Every selected source has a visible outcome. Every model-visible tool has a tested dispatch path. Unknown fields remain unknown. No mandatory paid dependency exists in the baseline. Installation, disablement, uninstall and restore work. The release description lists automatic and link-only sources separately.

18. Decisions, risks and release checklist
Architecture decisions

ADR-01 — Native first, optional gateway. Matches the reviewed compiled-adapter catalog and keeps normal Android use independent of a computer. A gateway is introduced only for a concrete authorized capability, not as the mandatory front door. [R2, R3]

ADR-02 — Three result types, not one ambiguous product list. Retrieved listings, discoveries and external searches have different evidentiary meanings. Their counts and badges cannot be merged into a success metric.

ADR-03 — One plugin, independent provider readiness. A missing API credential or blocked provider does not disable search links or unrelated approved sources. Native UI and AI tools use the same coordinator.
ADR-04 — Read-only launch. Keep purchases, seller communication and accounts outside scope. This reduces sensitive permissions and makes search reliability independently testable.

ADR-05 — No universal scraping fallback. Publicly available source code does not establish platform permission, current working access or a reusable license. Data access and software licensing are separate release checks.
Key risks and mitigations

blocks.text: Final release checklist

Confirm the exact shipped adapter versions and pin reviewed external dependencies. Confirm permission, license and regional status for every automatic source. Verify zero-key phone-only onboarding. Verify no embedded shared secrets or session capture. Verify cached data and backups respect retention and consent. Verify all advertised controls are implemented, tool results are visible, and existing Amazon/chat functionality is unchanged.

State unresolved external gates prominently: eBay production approval is not demonstrated here; Facebook/Craigslist/Kijiji automatic retrieval is not enabled by this design; external repositories were reviewed as references, not live-tested connectors; source display, caching and monitoring rights require release-specific confirmation.

Release claim: “One place to search supported sources, compare retrieved listings and open searches on other marketplaces.” Avoid “all listings,” “all sites searched live,” “guaranteed best price” and “unlimited free API access.”
